card.name: Mambo
card.tagline: Cuban dance/music from the danzon-mambo, popularized by Perez Prado.
card.profile: Mambo is a Cuban dance and music genre. The music traces to the danzon de nuevo ritmo (danzon-mambo) created in the late 1930s by Orestes Lopez and Israel 'Cachao' Lopez in Antonio Arcano's charanga; the term derives from their 1938 danzon 'Mambo.' The original Cuban/Mexican ballroom dance (faster, less rigid than danzon) replaced rhumba as the fashionable US Latin dance; Damaso Perez Prado popularized it internationally from Mexico in the 1950s. A later New York breaking-step form became 'mambo on 2' (closely tied to salsa) (English Wikipedia).
card.insight: The original Cuban mambo dance had no basic breaking steps - Cuban dancers described it as 'feeling the music' - and US dance teachers standardized it for the commercial ballroom market (English Wikipedia).
